newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixed at $345.85 high since April 14.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixed at $345.85 high since April 14.

text.p: Gold fixed at $345.85 per ounce on Friday afternoon, its highest fixing since April 14, 1997.
It had fixed at $344.80 at the morning fixing up from $343.75 on Thursday afternoon.
Dealers said the slide in dollar and bond yield values over the past couple of day's had lifted gold out of its narrow $340-$344 range of the past three weeks.
"It is largely short covering by the funds and professionals," one dealer said.
The dollar slipped to a low of 121.45 yen and just over 1.69 mark earlier on Friday.
Dealers said gold holding above $345 today would be helpful for the market but very heavy selling was expected if it got to $350.
